sources.name: USPS – Postal Bulletin / Pictorial Postmarks
sources.note: Ermittelt Ausgabenummern über offizielle PDF-URLs; einzelne Pictorial Postmarks stehen im Heft und werden noch nicht automatisch ausgelesen. Jahres-/Startnummer gegebenenfalls anpassen.

sources.name: Royal Mail – Postmark Bulletin
sources.summary: Offizielles Handstamp-Bulletin; Auslandsfrist und jeweiliges Handstamp Centre im Original überprüfen.

sources.name: Schweizer Post – PhilaNews
sources.summary: Offizielle PhilaNews: Ausgabetagsstempel, Sonderstempel, Letzttagsstempel und Einlieferungsfristen im PDF nachlesen.

sources.name: Österreichische Post – Sonderpostämter
sources.summary: Offizielle PDF-Übersicht zu Sonderpostämtern und Sonderstempeln; Stempelwünsche rechtzeitig einreichen.

sources.name: Österreichische Post – Philatelietage
sources.summary: Offizielle Termine für Philatelietage; Stempelangebot bei der Post überprüfen.

sources.name: Australia Post – Stamp Bulletin
sources.summary: Offizielles Stamp Bulletin als PDF; Angaben zu Ersttagsbelegen und Stempeln im Heft prüfen.

sources.name: Åland Post – offizielle Bildmotiv- und Sonderstempel
sources.note: Wichtige Originalquelle mit Märket-Leuchtturmstempel und Konditionen; keine zuverlässig datierte Bulletinliste. In ChatGPT-Suche aktiv, im ZIP nur als kuratierte Referenz.

sources.name: Canada Post – Details / Stamp Catalogue
sources.note: Offizieller Katalog ist bestätigt; Filter und PDF-Verweise müssen für vollautomatische Nutzung noch live getestet werden.

sources.name: NZ Post – Collectables / Ross Dependency
sources.note: Offizieller Ausgaben-Katalog mit Ross Dependency; für automatische Erfassung einzelner Ausgaben ist ein eigener Parser nötig.

sources.name: An Post – Stamp Programme
sources.note: Offizielles Jahresprogramm, aber kein eindeutig versioniertes Bulletin; noch nicht automatisch auswertbar.

sources.name: PostNord Schweden – Frimärksåret
sources.note: Offizielles schwedisches Ausgabeprogramm; Parser noch nicht implementiert.

sources.name: British Antarctic Survey – News (Feed-Kandidat)
sources.note: Nur nach erfolgreicher RSS-Validierung aktivieren. Forschungsnachrichten sind keine bestätigten Stempelmöglichkeiten.

sources.name: Belgium · bpost/Bephila · Philanews
sources.note: bpost's Bephila collector programme and Philanews magazines include advance sales and first-day cancellations. Research reference; bulletin extraction requires separate validation.

sources.name: Bulgaria · Bulgarian Posts · Philatelic news
sources.note: Official news posts include stamp-launch events and special postal handstamps; general news page needs a topic-sensitive parser.

sources.name: Croatia · Hrvatska pošta · Special cancellations
sources.note: Dedicated official Croatian postmark catalogue (Prigodni žigovi), searchable by year; dynamic/filter-dependent structure needs a reliable importer.

sources.name: Cyprus · Cyprus Post · Stamp issues & FDCs
sources.note: Official Cyprus Post announcements document stamp programmes and first-day covers; individual posts are not always special-cancellation announcements.

sources.name: Estonia · Omniva · Philatelic news
sources.note: Official news stories on stamp issues, first-day covers and sometimes exceptional handstamps; philatelic selection needed.

sources.name: Finland · Posti · Stamp issues & cancellations
sources.note: Posti's official philatelic catalogue; single stamp releases and special cancellations require different handling.

sources.name: France · Philaposte · Philinfo
sources.summary: Official Philinfo magazine with first-day cancellations, temporary postal offices and postal administration information; read the PDF for dates and conditions.
sources.note: Automatic detection targets Philinfo PDF filenames only; it does NOT extract individual special-handstamp events. PDF link availability and site HTML may change.

sources.name: Greece · ELTA · Special cancellations
sources.note: Official ELTA philatelic portal includes individual commemorative handstamps and mail-in request periods; year-specific listing will need updating for 2027.

sources.name: Italy · Poste Italiane · Filatelia
sources.note: Official Poste Italiane philatelic store and news mention annulli speciali; a complete and reliably current dedicated cancellation feed was not verified.

sources.name: Latvia · Latvijas Pasts · Philatelic news
sources.note: Official announcements frequently contain first-day handstamp date and location; structured per-article parsing not yet tested.

sources.name: Lithuania · Lietuvos paštas · Cancellation & stamp plan
sources.note: Official planned stamp issues and cancellation schedule; supplement with Ekspresinformacija PDF bulletins. No importer yet.

sources.name: Luxembourg · POST Philately · PhilatéLux
sources.summary: Official PhilatéLux collector magazine with issues and special cancellation information; open each PDF for exact dates and postmark conditions.
sources.note: Automatic PDF-link detection only, not a complete special-cancellation or eligibility parser. This English magazine can have variant filenames.

sources.name: Malta · MaltaPost · Special handstamps
sources.summary: Official MaltaPost special-handstamp announcement. Verify the cancellation-use date, location and philatelic order procedure in the linked original article.
sources.note: New-item detection is from the dated official news table; page publication date is NOT necessarily the special-handstamp usage date.

sources.name: Netherlands · PostNL · First-day covers
sources.note: Official PostNL first-day-cover catalogue; not a comprehensive source for independent commemorative handstamps.

sources.name: Portugal · CTT · Philatelic issue plan
sources.note: Official stamp issue plan identifies some first-day cancellation offices; the monthly release page is a supplemental reference.

sources.name: Slovakia · Slovenská pošta · POFIS
sources.note: Official POFIS philatelic programme includes first-day covers and special postmarks; individual issue-page parsing not yet validated.

sources.name: Slovenia · Pošta Slovenije · Philatelic Bulletin
sources.summary: Official tri-lingual philatelic Bulletin. Contains current stamp issues and postmark illustrations; no individual cancellation extraction.
sources.note: Official 5x/year issue archive; detection by PDF bulletin number and link. Individual postmarks are not parsed.

sources.name: Spain · Correos · Official postmark catalogue
sources.note: Official Correos distinguishes commemorative, special, operative, presentation and first-day cancellations; dynamic catalogue requires its own importer.

sources.name: Guernsey Post – Guernsey, Alderney and Sark philatelic news
sources.summary: Official Guernsey Post news about stamp issues and related products; check original announcement for cancellations. Not a special-postmark bulletin.

sources.name: Jersey Post – Philatelic Bureau news
sources.summary: Official Jersey Post philatelic bureau news; articles can cover releases, FDCs or general bureau updates, not automatically individual cancellations.

sources.name: Faroe Islands – Posta Stamps philatelic magazine
sources.summary: Official Faroese Posta Stamps magazine PDF with release information; inspect PDF for individual issue dates, postmarks and terms.

sources.name: Philatelie Liechtenstein – Official new-issue brochures
sources.summary: Official Liechtenstein issue brochures with FDC information and philatelic dates; individual cancellations must be verified in the original.

sources.name: Isle of Man Post Office – Stamp news
sources.summary: Official Isle of Man Post Office news related to stamps and coins; generic postal service releases are filtered out by title.

eurozone_research.scope: 21 EU euro-area members in postage/rates.json; overseas territories and non-euro-area EUR users are intentionally outside this 21-country inventory
